checks.details: Reviewed direct-detection chiral power counting through O(p3), two-nucleon electromagnetic charge operators through one loop, and fourth-order nuclear electromagnetic four-current/continuity results.

In the HKS direct-detection counting, the AV two-body vector current appears at O(p2), with AV NLO corrections at O(p3). Table 1 places the first VV two-body time component at O(p4); the spatial piece is O(p2) in the nucleon current plus O(p2) WIMP-spatial suppression, also effective O(p4).
The three-flavor universal source is identified as three times the baryon-number current in the three-flavor low-energy theory. Electromagnetic operators are not treated as drop-in replacements.

The Hu et al. VS-IMSRG/NAT workflow is a method reference for Xe-129/Xe-131; the public repository contains spin-dependent response fits, not the required VV vector-current operators or matrix elements.
The LZ private Actions runner has repeatedly failed to provision (runner_id=0, zero steps). No central machine-validator PASS is claimed.

The SU(2) source is explicitly embedded as r_mu=l_mu=0 and v_mu^(s)=B_mu. The factor of two is relative only to the isolated electromagnetic isoscalar source v_mu^(s)=e A_mu/2, not to the full electromagnetic current.

Identified the isoscalar tau1 dot tau2 projection of the one-pion-exchange charge, the U(1)_B identity substitution in short-range C2/C4/C5/C7 current terms, and the surviving isoscalar L2 magnetic contact. Unitary phases beta8/beta9 must be fixed consistently with the selected NN potential.

IMSRG++ supports NAT, VS-IMSRG and ensemble normal ordering. NuHamil supplies NN+3N matrix elements and a Tmag NLO vector multipole, but source inspection shows its Tz0 operator uses rank-one isospin tau1 tau2 (isovector), not U(1)_B; N3LO vector currents and two-body charge are not implemented. Hu's repository contains fitted axial Sigma responses but not raw NN+3N inputs or VV operators; exact Hu interaction reproduction is not claimed.
